propositions: Fourteen test modules hand-build nested pytest invocations with duplicated logic around basetemp, timeout, cache plugin and env, introducing maintenance burden and defect surface.

Three test sites lack --basetemp entirely: test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py:25 (executing real integration nodes, live defect instance), test_git_version_floor.py:164, and test_live_jira_xdist_confinement.py:161.
A centralized run_nested_pytest helper must forward env verbatim without modification, to preserve security-critical minimal environment mappings used in four repr-safety tests.
The helper must make tmp_path parent directories before passing --basetemp to pytest, because pytest fails with FileNotFoundError when basetemp parents do not exist.
TimeoutExpired must propagate unmodified from subprocess.run, and CompletedProcess must be returned by identity, so existing exception handling and result assertions continue working.
An AST-based uniqueness guard must verify exactly one nested-pytest launch site and one helper definition exist, catching hand-built launches before they re-enter the codebase.
